title: Echoes of the Homeland
description: Colonial messengers have posted demands across the territory. Mekatilili must inspect the village shamba, consult Elder Mzee Fondo, and unite with Kaya elder Wanje wa Mwadorikola.

objectives.description: Walk around the village, speak with the elders, and help a fellow villager.
Help Villager Nyevu tend and harvest traditional cassava in the village shamba.
Consult Elder Mzee Fondo at the Sacred Council Baobab.
Unite with Kaya elder Wanje wa Mwadorikola to prepare the community for resistance.
Convene the village gathering at the council fire and swear the sacred resistance oath.

reward_text: The people of Ulungu are united. Community support reached 100%.
